description: This file defines the PolicyAdministrationPointInterface, an interface for managing access control policies in the Mattermost server, including methods for initializing, validating, querying, saving, and deleting policies.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the policy administration point and CEL engine; idempotent operation.

methods.name: GetPolicyRuleAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of a specified policy for a given action.

methods.name: CheckExpression
methods.description: Validates the given expression using the CEL engine; returns errors if invalid.

methods.name: ExpressionToVisualAST
methods.description: Converts an expression to a visual abstract syntax tree.

methods.name: NormalizePolicy
methods.description: Restores policy IDs back to names for normalization.

methods.name: QueryUsersForExpression
methods.description: Finds users matching a given expression.

methods.name: QueryUsersForResource
methods.description: Finds users matching a resource and action.

methods.name: GetChannelMembersToRemove
methods.description: Retrieves channel members to be removed from a specified channel.

methods.name: GetPoliciesForFieldIDs
methods.description: Retrieves policies referencing specific property field IDs.
